entries.peakNoticeLabel: Prominent notice during peak hours (sidebar budget box, today's cost; previewed in the Settings peak panel)
entries.badgeNote: Session cost uses call-time prices, including peak and historical rates. Input, output, cache reads and writes are separate; configured cache-write and long-context rates apply.
entries.pricingCurrencyNote: Selects the official pricing-page language. Synced prices apply to subsequent calls.
entries.priceTableNote: Pro and Flash use separate official rates; legacy Flash names use Flash rates. Weekday peaks are 01–04 and 06–10 UTC; weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak. Rate changes apply to later calls. Recorded amounts remain until you confirm historical recalculation. Cache writes use hit rates.
entries.datedPriceNote: Current rates are shown here. Editing cancels any future scheduled change for this entry; earlier historical rates are retained.
entries.confirmFetch: Overwrite the price table with prices from the official docs?
entries.syncScopeNote: Official sync updates DeepSeek prices (including peak rates). Third-party prices (z-ai/Kimi/Qwen/Volcano) follow releases; expand a vendor group in the price table or use model matching.
entries.confirmImportLegacy: Confirm import? Replays all session logs and only fills dates/sessions missing from the ledger; existing records are untouched.
entries.legacyImportNote: Pre-install history imports at first launch; rerun after copying old logs. Costs use current prices. Deleted logs cannot replay; sessions spanning installation exclude earlier usage.
